title: The Void Has a Sense of Humor
logline: When a crying, phone-clutching user runs from the Void, Jesus walks up and tells it a joke; the Void laughs up galaxies, wants a word, gets refused and blocked, and walks off giggling into the sunset; and, in a bonus memory, the same Void quietly mule-kicks a Depression Magician into the buckets so it can have a moment with my fear.

voice_notes.NARRATOR: The storyteller, the 'I', spinning a daydream out loud for one friend and half cracking up at it. Same gender-neutral voice as the earlier film, but present tense and playful: 'let's say' is a magic wand. Warm, wry, quick, with a laugh always one breath away (on 'Maniacally', on the block, 'too intensely', 'Bonus scene') and never mocking anybody. Drops into a conspiratorial hush for whispers and side-eyes. Tender and slow when it matters: 'with a sad little smile', and the last lines of the bonus. The final 'Tee-hee.' is soft, delighted and a little moved.
voice_notes.JESUS: Warm, unhurried, playful, utterly unafraid; the voice of someone who smiles while he talks. A gentle tease, never preachy. His comedy is his sincerity: 'The void's got a pretty good sense of humor' is a cozy recommendation; 'Tee-hee' is a real little giggle; 'Mm-hm. No, totally.' sounds like a phone call with a friend; 'Oh, boy' comes out through clenched teeth. To the user he goes quiet, low and level, every word placed, until the enthusiasm bursts out on 'more about emotions!' and 'meaningful to me!': brighter, faster, too much, too soon. 'Fair enough' is light and gracious.
voice_notes.USER: Young, quick, gender-ambiguous-to-feminine, the voice scraped thin from crying. Fear comes out as sarcasm: fast, flat, clipped. 'What the actual f***?!' cracks high, half sob, half shout. 'Why is it looking at me like that.' is muttered dread with no question lift. 'Hell no' is flat and absolute; 'scary thing' wobbles and gives them away.
voice_notes.FEAR: Small, breathy, high, quick to crack; the same Fear as the earlier film. One short line, a worried little stammer: 'What's... what's that noise?'
voice_notes.MAGICIAN: A theatrical, slithery stage-magician voice in a stage whisper: wet consonants, savoring every word, a giddy creepy giggle underneath. Comic menace, never truly frightening.
voice_notes.VOID: Never speaks words. All vocals are non-verbal and musical: a huge booming laugh that collapses into wheezes and squeaky giggles; airy starry whispers we can never understand; kettle-like huffs that puff out nebulae; a long soft sigh; a bubbly, surprisingly high giggle; a snort that sprays stars; an innocent two-note hum. Its face does the talking.

scenes.purpose: A bright, inviting first frame that sells the whole premise in one glance: a crying kid with a phone fleeing a huge, soft, starry presence across a pastel dream at golden hour. We laugh a little, worry a little, and notice something the kid can't: the Void isn't hunting anyone. It's trying to say 'wait'.

music.mood: comic-anxious scurry over a warm dusk
music.instrumentation: pizzicato strings, light marimba, a soft low clarinet on each of the Void's footfalls, warm string pad underneath

beats.shot: OPENING STILL / THUMBNAIL. Frame 0 is the finished, fully lit image: no fade from black, nothing fading up. 35mm-feel lens, camera at chest height, tracking backward down the pale winding path at running speed. Lower-middle: the USER running straight at camera, framed knees-up, face at y≈520, mid-sob. Upper-middle: on the crest of the peach hill behind them, the VOID, huge and round, its eyes at y≈280, its own private pocket of indigo starry sky hanging above it, violet-to-teal rim glow against the gold. Around them: lilac and mint hills, a rose-gold crystal tree at left, the enormous low warm sun far down the path at right, three or four glowing thought-seeds drifting in the light. The title 'The Void Has a Sense of Humor' in soft cream rounded lettering sits fully opaque in the indigo sky at y≈140-270, centered; it holds through this beat and fades out over the first 1.5 s of the next. Warm sun rim on both characters; the phone screen throws a cool white glow on the user's chin. Nothing important below y≈850.
beats.action: The user runs toward us, crying, phone clutched to their chest; behind them the Void plods after them on short fat legs, one big hand half-raised. A thought-seed drifts across the top third.

acting.USER: In pose on frame 0, eyes open (never mid-blink), never a smear: right foot planted, left arm pumping, right hand clutching the phone to the sternum. Eyes huge and wet, pupils small, lower lids shoved up by the sob, inner brows yanked up and together, mouth a wide open sob-square, a tear streak catching gold on each cheek; cowlick bouncing; glasses slightly askew. At 1.0 s a look back over the left shoulder (the eyes lead, the head follows 3 frames later), a sharp gasp-breath, and the eyes snap forward even wider.
acting.VOID: Not menacing, and the frame should say so: eyes big and round, lids high, brow-wisps tilted up in the middle (worried, hopeful), mouth a small soft 'o'. Its right hand is half-raised out of the sleeve, four fingers spread, the gesture of someone calling 'wait, hang on'. Each step sets its whole round body jiggling like a water balloon; a star mote lifts off one shoulder.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: So, let's say there's a Twitter user...
beats.delivery: warm and conspiratorial, a smile in the voice, like starting a daydream out loud for one friend; a tiny breath after 'So,'; a little lift on the last two words, as if picturing them
beats.shot: Continue the backward track while the title finishes fading out; drift a touch closer so the user fills more of the middle (face y≈480).
beats.action: The user keeps running at us down the path, phone in hand.

acting.USER: Runs, sobbing in rhythm with the stride, a hitched breath every second step. Mid-run the eyes drop to the phone for 6 frames (habit, even now), the thumb twitches across it, then the eyes jerk back up.
acting.VOID: Plods behind, hand still half-raised, eyes fixed hopefully on the user's back.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: crying, and running from the ~void.
beats.delivery: a little slower, mock-solemn on 'running from the void' (the low notes do the drama for us), a suppressed laugh caught in the breath at the end
beats.shot: Cut to a low side-tracking medium wide, camera at hip height, 28mm feel, running alongside: the USER crosses frame right-to-left in the middle (head y≈420); the VOID fills the right half behind them (eyes y≈250), its starry sky-pocket following overhead like a small personal weather system.
beats.action: On 'crying', a sob visibly shakes the user's shoulders; on 'running from the void', the Void keeps pace behind them with surprisingly quick, short, round shuffle-steps under its hem.

acting.USER: On 'crying', the chin crumples, the eyes squeeze to wet slits, and two little tears fly off sideways as glints. On 'void', a frantic look back: the eyes lock onto the Void for 6 frames, pupils pin, the mouth stretches into a silent scream-grimace, teeth showing.
acting.VOID: When the user looks back, the Void's eyes brighten and its raised hand gives a tiny hopeful wave, two finger-wiggles. The user's face contorts; the hand freezes mid-wiggle, and the brow-wisps sink at the outer ends. It keeps following anyway.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.shot: Close front-tracking on the USER's face (face y≈400), the Void a soft dark blur over their shoulder.
beats.action: The user whimpers as they run.

acting.USER: A high whimper through a clenched, wobbling mouth. The glasses slide down the nose and get shoved back up with the phone hand in one panicked motion; the eyes dart left-right-left, looking for anywhere to go. Breath ragged; nostrils flaring.
acting.VOID: Out of focus behind them, still coming, hand still up.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Which, to be fair, is pretty ~big.
beats.delivery: a dry aside, deadpan, half a laugh held back; slowing right down on 'pretty big'
beats.shot: Cut to a wide from low on the path ahead, 24mm feel: the USER small in the lower-middle (head y≈600) sprinting toward camera; the VOID rising behind them all the way up to y≈150, its full round bulk and hood against its indigo sky-pocket, gold sky on both sides.
beats.action: The line is illustrated literally: the Void's sheer size fills the frame behind the tiny running user.

acting.VOID: Lumbers on. Both hands are now lifted a little from the sleeves, palms out, as if to say 'I come in peace'. The effort shows: lids a little heavy, small puffs of star-breath motes from the mouth with each step, the round body bouncing.
acting.USER: Arms starting to pinwheel; running is clearly not their sport; one sneaker scuffs.

scenes.purpose: Jesus arrives on the storyteller's cue, and in one look he understands everything: the terror, the tears, and the Void, whom he seems to recognize like an old friend. He is not afraid, and the camera knows it.

music.mood: a warm, light surprise; the chase thins out
music.instrumentation: a celesta glint on his arrival, harp roll, warm strings; the pizzicato chase falls away to a few plucks

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And let's say Jesus appears.
beats.delivery: breezy, as if it's the most obvious next step in any story; a small lift on 'appears', then waiting for it
beats.shot: Cut to a medium wide of an empty bend in the path ahead, beside a rounded rose-gold crystal tree, the low sun behind it. The center of the frame (y≈300-800) is left open and empty for a moment.
beats.action: On 'appears', a few slow golden motes gather in the air above the empty path, like dust in a sunbeam, but nobody is there yet. Far in the left background, the USER is running toward this bend.

acting.USER: Tiny in the far background, still running, still sobbing.
acting.JESUS: Not yet visible: only the gathering motes where he will stand.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: ^Now.
beats.delivery: a tiny satisfied snap in the voice, the storyteller cueing him in; short and bright
beats.shot: Same frame, locked off.
beats.action: On 'Now', the motes resolve and JESUS is simply there, mid-stroll on the path, as if he'd been walking along it the whole time. No flash: only a soft warm rim glow settling onto his hair and shoulders.

acting.JESUS: Appears mid-step and relaxed: hands loosely clasped behind his back, head tilted up toward the sky, eyes half-lidded in plain contentment, an easy closed-mouth smile. A slow breath of pleasant evening air lifts his chest. He takes one more ambling step, sandals soft on the path.
acting.USER: Still far off in the background, running this way.

beats.shot: Medium on JESUS, waist up, face y≈380, 50mm feel, camera steady. The USER enters frame left in the midground and runs right past behind him; the hem and stubby feet of the VOID shuffle through the far background after them.
beats.action: Jesus sees the user crying and running from the Void.

acting.JESUS: The contented look breaks at the sound of sobbing: the eyes open fully and saccade left toward it. They track the user across frame, the head following a beat behind. The smile falls away; the inner brows lift and draw together (compassion, not alarm); the lips part slightly. Then his eyes leave the user and travel up and back, to the Void. A blink. Something like recognition: the outer brows lift, one corner of the mouth twitches up. Oh. It's you.
acting.USER: Runs straight past without noticing him at all; a sob, another look back.
acting.VOID: Plods through the background, hands lifted, eyes on the user.

beats.shot: Cut to a medium wide, side view, camera at the user's knee height, 35mm: the path, the soft hill rising behind; the USER enters frame right, running leftward (head y≈420 while running, y≈640 once down).
beats.action: The user's chunky sneaker catches on absolutely nothing; they stumble, flail, and land hard on their backside on the path; scoot backward twice on heels and one hand; and throw the other hand up toward the Void, palm out.

acting.USER: The stumble: eyes go wide, mouth an 'O', arms windmill, and the phone is held up high to save it (priorities). THUD on the backside: the whole face compresses on impact and the glasses jump. Scoot, scoot backward. The left hand shoots up, palm out, fingers splayed, at the Void; the right clutches the phone against the chest. Eyes enormous, pupils tiny, lower lids trembling, upper lids sky-high, brows up and tight; a frozen open-mouthed gasp; shoulders up at the ears.

beats.shot: Reverse, low angle from just behind the USER's raised hand (the hand soft in the foreground at y≈700) up to the VOID, which has stopped three metres away (eyes y≈260).
beats.action: The Void stops. Its half-raised hand hovers, then slowly lowers into its sleeve.

acting.VOID: Stops on one foot, wobbles, settles both feet. Its eyes go to the user's raised palm: a slow blink. The brow-wisps sink at the outer ends; the upper lids drift down to 70 percent and the lower lids lift a touch: a quiet, familiar sadness. The hand lowers back into the sleeve. Then it takes one tiny half-step backward, to give the user room.
acting.USER: In the foreground, the raised hand trembles; the breath comes in fast little gasps.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And he sees all of this.
beats.delivery: gentle and a little fond; slower; 'all of this' with a small lift, as if gesturing at the whole mess
beats.shot: Close on JESUS, face y≈420, a slow push-in.
beats.action: We watch Jesus take in all of it with his eyes.

acting.JESUS: Eyes go down-left to the user on the ground and hold 12 frames: inner brows up, mouth soft. Saccade up-right to the Void; hold; outer brows lift, a small warm crinkle at the eyes. Back to the user. Back to the Void. On 'this', a slow blink: the thought changes. When the lids open the eyes are bright and one corner of his mouth tucks up: he has an idea. A slight nod to himself.

beats.shot: Medium wide, 35mm, camera at the seated user's eye height: the USER on the ground in the lower-left foreground (head y≈640); JESUS walks in from frame right and passes them, heading for the VOID, who stands in the upper-middle background (eyes y≈240).
beats.action: Jesus walks past the user toward the Void, and as he passes he gives the user a small, calm, palm-down 'one sec' gesture.

acting.JESUS: An easy, unhurried walk. Passing the user he lowers his right palm in a gentle 'hold on, one sec', with a small reassuring smile and a nod, and does not break stride.
acting.USER: Eyes follow him (eyes lead, head follows slowly). The raised hand stays up but bends at the wrist in confusion. The mouth closes, then falls open again as it dawns on them where he is going.
acting.VOID: Sees him coming: the eyes widen, and it glances over its own shoulder behind itself, as if he must be walking toward somebody else. Nobody there. Its eyes come back to him, round and uncertain.

scenes.purpose: Fearless intimacy as comedy: the one person who walks toward the scary thing does it like greeting an old buddy. We never hear the joke; we watch it land on the Void's face in slow, precise stages.

music.instrumentation: pizzicato walking bass, a low clarinet, soft vibraphone, brushed snare

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: So Jesus walks right up to the void,
beats.delivery: brisk and delighted, like reporting something slightly outrageous; a light stress on 'right up'
beats.shot: Medium-wide two-shot from the side, 35mm: JESUS walks into frame left (face y≈430); the VOID towers at right (eyes y≈230); its starry sky-pocket overhead.
beats.action: Jesus walks right up to the Void and stops at its side, close enough to touch.

acting.JESUS: Arrives with a little hop on the last step and looks up at it with a big friendly smile, brows raised, the face of someone spotting a buddy across a party.
acting.VOID: Leans back slightly as he arrives: eyes wide, lids up, brow-wisps up and apart, mouth a small surprised 'o'. A star mote pops off its shoulder.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.text: Wait. What are you doing?
beats.delivery: a frantic whisper-shout, the voice scraped thin from crying, too fast
beats.shot: Quick cut: close on the USER on the ground (face y≈420), the two figures soft behind them.
beats.action: From the ground, the user whisper-yells at Jesus.

acting.USER: Lip-synced. Leans forward on the free hand; the eyes flick between Jesus and the Void, Jesus and the Void; brows knotted with the inner corners up; the mouth pulls wide and tense on 'doing'; two quick tiny head shakes, no-no.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: puts his arm around it,
beats.delivery: rolling on, warmer, enjoying this
beats.shot: Back to the side two-shot, a little tighter: Jesus waist-up, the Void's face and middle.
beats.action: Jesus puts his arm around the Void; it is so wide that his hand only reaches the velvet curve of its side.

acting.JESUS: Lifts his right arm and drapes it around the Void as far as it will go, which is not far; settles it with a pat; looks up with a wide smile and an eyebrow bounce, 'hey, buddy'.
acting.VOID: Freezes. Its eyes drop hard to the arm around it, slide to Jesus's face, drop to the arm again: two quick blinks. Its hands float up a few centimetres from the sleeves, not knowing what to do with themselves, then sink. Stiff as a startled cat, shoulders up around the hood.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: and starts whispering in its ear.
beats.delivery: dropping into a whisper on 'whispering', as if we're in on it now
beats.shot: Slow push to a medium two-shot of their heads: the Void bends down until its hood is level with Jesus's face (both faces y≈330-400).
beats.action: The Void bends down; Jesus rises onto tiptoe, cups a hand beside his mouth, and starts whispering into the side of its hood.

acting.JESUS: Up on tiptoe; left hand cupped beside his mouth; eyes twinkling sideways at it; brows lifting in small conspiratorial hops; lips moving close to the hood.
acting.VOID: Lowers its huge hood slowly toward him, the way a tall friend bends to hear in a loud room. The eyes slide toward him, then lose focus: listening.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.caption: (whispers a joke)
beats.shot: Close-up on the VOID's face (eyes y≈380), Jesus's cupped hand and bearded profile soft at frame left. A very slow push-in.
beats.action: Jesus whispers the joke. We never hear the words. It lands on the Void's face in stages.

acting.VOID: 0.0 s: listening, eyes unfocused, lids neutral, mouth closed. 0.8 s: one brow-wisp lifts at its outer end, skeptical. 1.4 s: the eyes slide toward Jesus and narrow slightly, 'really?' 2.0 s: the lower lids push up (a smile starting behind the eyes) while the mouth stays pressed in a flat line. 2.6 s: the corners of the crescent mouth twitch, twice; a tiny star squeaks out of one corner. 3.2 s: the eyes squeeze shut into upturned arcs.
acting.JESUS: Whispering steadily; between phrases his own lips press together to keep from laughing at his own joke; his shoulders give one tiny shake.

beats.shot: Pull back to the medium two-shot; the USER is visible small and soft at the lower-left edge (head y≈700).
beats.action: The Void tries very hard not to laugh.

acting.VOID: Clamps a big hand over its mouth. Its whole round body quivers; the eyes are squeezed into wet, shining arcs; two star motes leak out between its fingers; under the hem the fat feet do a small involuntary shuffle-dance.
acting.JESUS: Drops back onto his heels, eyebrows up, lips pressed in an expectant grin, watching it fight; one small nod: wait for it.
acting.USER: Staring, mouth open, phone held up in front of the face as if it could protect them.

scenes.purpose: The release: an enormous, maniacal, joyful laugh that spills stars and galaxies. Funny because it's huge; touching because the Void clearly hasn't laughed like this in a very long time; terrifying, from where the user is sitting.

music.instrumentation: a timpani roll and low brass on the burst, then glockenspiel and harp glissandi on the stars, a bouncing bassoon underneath

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.caption: (maniacal cosmic laughter)
beats.shot: Cut on the burst to a low-angle medium wide, camera at Jesus's chest height, 28mm: the VOID's head thrown back (eyes y≈220), JESUS beside it at frame left (face y≈470), the star sky-pocket above.
beats.action: The Void bursts out laughing: the head thrown back, the mouth wide open into a crescent full of stars.

acting.VOID: The hand flies off its mouth; the hood snaps back; the mouth opens into a huge crescent with deep cosmos and stars inside; eyes squeezed into tight upturned arcs; brow-wisps fly up; the whole body bounces on each 'HA'; both hands clutch its round belly.
acting.JESUS: Laughs silently along with it: shoulders shaking, eyes crinkled shut, one hand on its side.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And then the void starts laughing. ^Maniacally.
beats.delivery: trying not to crack up; a hiccup of laughter before 'Maniacally', which is then said with delighted precision
beats.shot: Hold the low-angle wide; a gentle 5-degree orbit around them.
beats.action: The Void keeps laughing, maniacally, rocking on its fat little legs.

acting.VOID: Rocks backward and forward; one fat leg lifts and stamps; it slaps the side of its own cloak.
acting.JESUS: Laughing, wiping the corner of one eye with a knuckle.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: (continues under the narration)
beats.action: The laughter rolls on under the narration.

acting.VOID: Peal after peal, with whistling wheezes between them; tiny starry tears leak from the eye-arcs.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: So hard, it's coughing up ^stars...
beats.delivery: building, awed and amused at once
beats.shot: Cut to close on the VOID's face (mouth y≈430), stars visible inside the crescent.
beats.action: On 'coughing up stars', the Void coughs mid-laugh and a spray of little bright stars pops out of its mouth and floats upward, twinkling.

acting.VOID: A cough doubles it forward mid-laugh: the eyes pop open in surprise as a puff of stars bursts out of the mouth; it looks at them; it laughs even harder.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: (under the line)
beats.action: Cough, laugh, cough: stars spill out with each one.

acting.VOID: Each cough pops out another little cluster of stars.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: and little galaxies.
beats.delivery: a delighted little squeak of disbelief on 'galaxies'
beats.shot: Medium on both: a tiny violet-and-teal spiral galaxy drifts up out of the Void's mouth and turns lazily between their faces (y≈350).
beats.action: The Void coughs up a little spiral galaxy; it floats up, spinning slowly, between them.

acting.VOID: Coughs the galaxy out, then watches it go, eyes converging cross-eyed on it for a beat; then laughs harder.
acting.JESUS: Leans back to let the galaxy pass his nose, eyes following it up, a delighted 'ooh' mouth; then he's laughing again too.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: (under the line)
beats.action: One big cough-hiccup produces the galaxy.

acting.VOID: One big hiccuping cough.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Wider, 28mm: both in the upper two-thirds; the Void doubled over laughing, Jesus with his arm around it patting its back; coughed-up stars and two little galaxies rise into its indigo sky-pocket and join the stars already there.
beats.action: Jesus pats the Void's back while it laughs; the coughed-up stars drift up and become part of the sky above it.

acting.VOID: Doubled over, one hand on Jesus's shoulder for support, the other on its belly; the laughter thinning into wheezy high squeaks.
acting.JESUS: Patting its back in rhythm and laughing with his whole face: eyes closed into crescents, mouth open in a warm laugh.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.shot: (under the Void's laugh)
beats.action: Jesus laughs with it.

acting.JESUS: A soft, warm, breathy laugh under the Void's.

beats.shot: Cut to the USER on the ground, medium close (face y≈430); the laughing pair small and soft in the background, framed between the user's raised hand and head.
beats.action: The user stares. A little coughed-up galaxy drifts slowly past their face.

acting.USER: Still on their backside, one hand up, terror in the eyes, now mixed with total incomprehension: eyes wide and unblinking; the brows can't decide (left up, right down); jaw hanging. The little galaxy drifts past their nose; the eyes cross to follow it, then snap back to the Void. One slow, disbelieving blink.

scenes.purpose: The title line lands. Jesus, still glowing from the laugh, tells the terrified kid that the Void is funny, as if that settles everything. The comedy is the canyon between his ease and their terror, and the 'tee-hee' that falls into it.

music.mood: a cheeky little cadence, then held breath
music.instrumentation: solo clarinet, harp, pizzicato; a glock note on 'humor'

beats.shot: Medium on JESUS (face y≈400), his arm still around the Void, which chuckles in the soft background.
beats.action: Jesus turns and looks at the user.

acting.JESUS: Still catching his breath; wipes one eye with a knuckle; then his head turns toward the user, the eyes arriving first, bright and wet with laughter; a contented exhale through the nose.
acting.VOID: Soft giggling aftershocks, its shoulders hiccupping.

beats.shot: Jesus's POV: high angle, 50mm, looking down at the USER on their backside on the path (face y≈480).
beats.action: The user, on their backside, one hand up, terror in their eyes.

acting.USER: Frozen: palm still up and out, fingers splayed and trembling; phone clutched to the chest; eyes wide with terror, lower lids quivering; mouth pulled back in a tight grimace; breath fast and shallow, the hoodie strings bouncing with it.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.text: The void's got a pretty good sense of ^humor.
beats.delivery: cheerful, cozy, completely sincere, like recommending a favourite restaurant; a lilt on 'pretty good'; 'humor' fond
beats.shot: Medium two-shot from the user's low angle: JESUS (face y≈380) with his arm around the VOID (eyes y≈200), both looking down at the user.
beats.action: Jesus tells the user the Void has a good sense of humor, presenting it with an open palm.

acting.JESUS: Lip-synced. Open palm toward the Void on 'the void's'; head tilts toward it; eyes sparkling; brows up and relaxed; on 'humor' a big warm smile and a little nod, as if this explains everything.
acting.VOID: On 'sense of humor' it straightens a little, pleased: brow-wisps lift, the mouth curls into a modest, slightly bashful crescent smile, and one hand gives a tiny 'oh, stop it' flap.

beats.shot: Cut to the USER, close (face y≈420).
beats.action: Nothing. The user just stares.

acting.USER: No reaction at all except one slow blink; the raised hand stays exactly where it is; a single tear drips off the chin.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.text: Tee-hee.
beats.delivery: a genuine little giggle in two soft high notes, quick, absolutely not ironic
beats.shot: Close on JESUS (face y≈400).
beats.action: Jesus giggles 'tee-hee', scrunching his shoulders.

acting.JESUS: Lip-synced. Shoulders scrunch up toward the ears, nose scrunches, eyes squeeze to happy crescents, a tiny bounce on the balls of his feet. Then, in the pause after, he opens his eyes, sees the user's face has not changed at all, and the smile holds a beat too long: the eyes do one tiny dart, the corners of the smile stiffen by a millimetre. A slow blink.

scenes.purpose: The user's disbelief explodes exactly as the Void's laugh dies. A comic bleep, a single polite star-hiccup, and two very different reactions to a swear word.

music.mood: near-silence for the punchline, a bassoon 'bwomp' after
music.instrumentation: bassoon, pizzicato, one glock ping on the star

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Wide three-shot, 35mm, camera low: the USER on the ground at lower left (face y≈640); JESUS and the VOID at upper right (faces y≈380 and y≈200).
beats.action: The Void's laughter winds down into its last little giggles.

acting.VOID: Winding down: a few hiccuping giggles, each smaller than the last; it wipes a starry tear with a knuckle and exhales a small cloud of nebula breath; the eyes reopening.
acting.JESUS: Smiling; two gentle pats on its back.
acting.USER: Shaking, breath held, staring at them.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.text: What the actual f***?!
beats.delivery: high, cracked, half sob and half shout, fast; the bleep lands like a rimshot
beats.shot: Cut to close on the USER (face y≈420).

beats.shot: Close on the VOID looking down (eyes y≈330).
beats.action: The Void looks at Fear with all the warmth in the world.

acting.VOID: Lids soft at half, eyes wet with starlight, a gentle smile; the brow-wisps relaxed and tilted up in the middle.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: with my fear.
beats.delivery: almost a whisper, warm; let it hang
beats.shot: Two-shot: Fear looks up at the Void; the Void looks down at Fear; galaxies turn slowly all around them.
beats.action: Fear and the Void have their moment.

acting.FEAR: Looks up, tear-bright, with a small, wondering smile.
acting.VOID: Looks down and smiles back.

beats.shot: Hold the two-shot; a slow, gentle orbit of a few degrees.
beats.action: The moment: the two of them in the light of the galaxies.

acting.FEAR: Leans its small body against the Void's hem, still holding the little galaxy; a slow, contented blink.
acting.VOID: Lowers one big hand and rests it, weightless, on Fear's shoulder.

beats.shot: Close on the VOID's face (eyes y≈360).
beats.action: The Void lets us in on the joke: a slow wink.

acting.VOID: Its eyes slide away from Fear and out toward us, toward the far glow of the screen of consciousness where I am watching; one eye closes in a slow wink; the crescent smile curls up at one corner.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Tee-hee.
beats.delivery: a soft, delighted little laugh, echoing Jesus
beats.shot: Hold close.
beats.action: The Void's wink holds into a smile.

acting.VOID: The winking eye reopens; the smile stays; it turns its gaze back down to Fear.

beats.shot: Pull back to a wide of the cosmos-filled back room: the Void and Fear small at center (y≈450-650). The title 'The Void Has a Sense of Humor' forms in soft cream lettering in the nebula above them (y≈170-300) and holds.
beats.action: End title in the nebula above the Void and Fear.

acting.VOID: Its hand on Fear's shoulder, swaying very slightly.
acting.FEAR: Holding its little galaxy up to the light.
